item.title: Robert Irwin flying flags supporting those suffering endometriosis
item.description:
Robert Irwin in 2024 sharing why men deserve to care about endometriosis, a disease that doesn't directly afflict many males.
Bindi Irwin posting about her journey with endometriosis. Why should men care about female physiology? Well, not only does half the population experience menstruation, menopause, endometriosis risks, the other (nearly) half of the population is attracted to women, sons of women, brothers of women, fathers of women. Guys can ask about women's topics to their mothers, sisters, partners, friends. Makes us a better person to be aware of others around us, especially those we care about.

item.description: The Sebright is a British breed of bantam chicken. It is a true bantam – a miniature bird with no corresponding large version – and is one of the oldest recorded British bantam breeds. It is named after Sir John Saunders Sebright, who created it as an ornamental breed by selective breeding in the early nineteenth century https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sebright_chicken

item.title: GovBrief Today #571
item.description: Six justices gave Donald Trump a head start on the midterms. The Supreme Court will let his election order take effect before any court rules on whether it's legal. The federal government now tells your state who counts as a citizen, and your state tells DC the name and address of everyone who votes by mail. The order directs the Attorney General to prioritize prosecuting local election officials who send ballots to anyone the administration says is ineligible. Trump's personal criminal defense lawyer was confirmed as Attorney General seventeen days ago. Federal judges already ruled the citizenship list illegal and ordered it dismantled. One wrote that the president has no power over elections at all. The Supreme Court overruled none of them but let Trump keep building while states begin mailing ballots in weeks. On whether any of this is legal, the majority wrote, "time will tell." I've emailed 8,784 stories over 571 straight nights, free and without ads. The algorithm can't show them all to you.
